# Alta Backcountry

> > A chronicle of wilderness expeditions and mountain living from the Colorado Rockies, featuring Arctic ski traverses across Greenland and Alaska, backcountry adventures, and reflections on life in wild places.

Written by Kevin and Elaine from their cabin in Eldora, Colorado, this blog documents major expeditions including Greenland Ice Sheet crossings, Alaska Range and Brooks Range adventures, and long-distance trails like the Great Divide Trail and Continental Divide Trail. The site combines expedition journals, gear reviews, and philosophical reflections on wilderness living.

## Key Topics

- Greenland Ice Sheet crossings
- Alaska Range and Brooks Range expeditions
- Backcountry skiing and ski touring
- Great Divide Trail and Continental Divide Trail
- Arctic travel and polar expeditions
- Eldora, Colorado mountain living
- Wilderness philosophy (Aldo Leopold)
- NOLS and outdoor education
- Expedition planning and logistics
- Nordic skiing and cross-country touring
- Colorado Rocky Mountains
- Thru-hiking adventures
- Wildlife encounters (wolves, wilderness)
- Cabin life and remote living
- Adventure photography

- [Going North in Midwinter – Alta Backcountry](https://altabackcountry.com/2026/02/21/going-north-in-midwinter): Midwinter nordic skiing trip to Alaska's interior after grief recovery
